name: Carolina CoPacking
old_description: Carolina CoPacking is a full-service co-packer of sauces, dressings, and rubs located in Henderson, North Carolina. Founded in 2018, CCP has grown its customer base with a reputation for quality and flexibility in meeting customers’ needs.
about:
Carolina CoPacking operates from Henderson, North Carolina, where it was founded in 2018. The company describes itself as a professionally run organization with a family-driven culture, though specific founders are not named publicly. It began as a full-service co-packer focused on sauces, dressings, and rubs, building a customer base through quality and flexibility.

The facility handles contract manufacturing, private label, and food service production, offering end-to-end services from product development and reformulation to cooking, bottling, packing, and shipping. The company notes it has expanded capacity recently and continually adopts new technology to increase efficiency. Its team comprises seasoned food-industry professionals who manage production and provide marketing support, packaging, and logistics.

Carolina CoPacking serves a range of clients from startup brands to large food-service groups and established retailers. It works with hundreds of brands across the sauce, dressing, and rub categories, helping them bring products to retail shelves and food-service channels. The company also assists with market insights and data analytics to help clients plan and scale.

The company emphasizes customer-focused production terms, fair and ethical partnerships, and leadership in food science and certification procedures. It differentiates itself by helping brands market to retailers, buyers, and consumers, using technology to track trends and maintain transparent communication. Reformulation services and supply-chain mitigation are also highlighted as key value drivers.
